name: Dousei
source:
The game begins with a pretty short prologue: One day, Masaki and Manami bump into each other. As if was guided by destiny, they got to knew each other because of that tiny accident and fell in love. Although everything did not go as smooth as their encounter, they still managed to maintain their relationship. After graduation they decided to start their new life together.

[Edited From [url=http://www.densetsu.com/display.php?id=456&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
